== Usage ==
This template is a replacement for {{tag|small}}. Not all browsers render {{tag|small|o}} at the same size, so this template uses {{tag|small|o|params=style="font-size:85%;"}} to use the semantics of {{tag|small|o}} while ensuring that the font renders the same size.

The only parameter is the content and may contain templates, images, etc., if a block needs to be wrapped in this template and contains such elements.  Note that if the <code>=</code> character appears in the content, the parameter must be explicitly specified as {{para|1}}.
:Thus <nowiki>{{small|1=3 + 2 = 5}}</nowiki> produces {{small|1=3 + 2 = 5}}

== See also ==
*{{tl|big}} - same idea, but larger instead of smaller. A shortcut for <code><nowiki><big>...</big></nowiki></code>
*{{tl|huge}} - for diacritic marks only; similar to {{tl|big}} but considerably larger, and compensates for vertical alignment.
*{{tl|resize}} - generic resizing
*{{tl|larger}} - not quite as large as {{tl|big}}
*{{tl|large}} - simply large
